title: Completing and submitting the questionnaire
purpose: Close the questionnaire. Remind non-Swiss employees and employees living abroad to bring their permit, and on submission record only the answers to questions that still apply.

stories.title: Remind employees to bring their permit on the first working day
stories.i_want: the questionnaire to remind every non-Swiss employee and every employee living abroad, at the end, to bring their permit on their first working day
stories.so_that: fewer new employees forget their permit on the first day (today about half of them forget), without collecting any additional data
stories.priority_reason: HR names a recurring pain ('Half of them forget'), but a forgotten permit does not block any registration; the reminder is a convenience that collects no data.

acceptance_criteria.title: Who sees the permit reminder
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has answered the country of their home address and, if they live in Switzerland, whether they hold Swiss citizenship
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee reaches the end of the questionnaire, before submitting it
acceptance_criteria.then: the permit reminder is shown if the employee lives outside Switzerland (whatever their nationality, which is not asked of them) or lives in Switzerland without Swiss citizenship; it is not shown to a Swiss citizen living in Switzerland

examples.name: Tomás - Brazilian, B permit, lives in Winterthur (hr_transcript/F-hr_transcript-d7431e)
Stefan - Swiss citizen living abroad (hr_transcript/F-hr_transcript-1a20bb); country of residence assumed Germany

acceptance_criteria.title: The reminder collects no data and is worded by HR
acceptance_criteria.given: the permit reminder is shown to an employee
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee reads it and continues to submit the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: the reminder asks for no answer, confirmation or document and records nothing; its purpose is to make the employee bring their permit on the first working day; HR provides the wording, which makes clear to a Swiss citizen living abroad that it does not apply to them

acceptance_criteria.title: No extra question only for the reminder
acceptance_criteria.when: the questionnaire decides whether to show the permit reminder
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is not asked about their citizenship for the reminder's sake; the reminder is shown to them anyway

stories.title: Discard answers that no longer apply on submission
stories.i_want: answers to questions that no longer apply after I change an earlier answer to be kept while I move back and forth, but dropped when I submit
stories.so_that: I lose no input while correcting myself, and Lonio records no personal data about me that no receiving party needs
stories.priority_reason: Data minimisation is a core constraint of the feature (G-01): keeping answers no party needs means holding personal data Lonio must not have.

acceptance_criteria.title: Answers are kept while the employee goes back and forth
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has answered follow-up questions and then changes an earlier answer so that those follow-up questions no longer apply
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee changes the earlier answer back before submitting
acceptance_criteria.then: the follow-up questions apply again and show the employee's earlier answers, so no input is lost

acceptance_criteria.title: Only answers to questions that still apply are recorded on submission
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee's latest answers mean that some questions they had answered earlier are no longer asked
acceptance_criteria.then: the answers to the questions that are no longer asked are discarded and not recorded for HR or any receiving party; only the answers to questions that apply to the latest answers are recorded

examples.name: Employee changed civil status from Married to Single - spouse's date of birth is discarded
Employee changed home country from Switzerland to Germany - canton and citizenship answers are discarded
Employee living in Switzerland changed Swiss citizenship from no to yes - C permit and source tax answers are discarded

stories.title: Questionnaire is read-only for the employee after submission
stories.i_want: the questionnaire to become read-only for the employee once submitted, with every derived result always based on the latest recorded answers
stories.so_that: later changes go through HR only, and results such as the insurance start date and the tariff code never fall out of step with the answers (as happened with Julia's changed start date)
stories.priority_reason: Prevents inconsistent derived results after changes (a known incident with the insurance start date), but the HR-side change process itself is specified later.

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee cannot change answers after submission
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee wants to change an answer (e.g. after a move, a marriage, a new child, a certificate of residence handed in later or a corrected nationality)
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee can view but not change their answers; such changes are made by HR, which is specified in the later HR-side spec

acceptance_criteria.title: Derived results always follow the latest answers
acceptance_criteria.given: an answer recorded for an employee has changed after submission
acceptance_criteria.when: the derived results are looked at
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date, the civil status for the pension fund and for source tax, whether the employee is subject to source tax and the tariff code are derived again from the latest answers; no history of earlier values is kept
